_doc: Cach goi CLI cua tung agent o che do headless. {prompt} duoc thay bang noi dung that. 'cmd' dung cho luot review (chi doc), 'write_cmd' dung cho luot tac gia (duoc sua artifact). Xem AGENTS.md muc 8.

claude.note: Can dang nhap truoc: chay `claude login` trong terminal that.

codex.note: CHUA KIEM CHUNG tren may nay — codex chua duoc cai. Cai bang `npm i -g @openai/codex`, roi chay `python scripts/orchestrate.py doctor --probe` va sua lai cac co o day neu sai.
